mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing increased kidney water recovery with absorption of a drink was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish slowing water loss from replacing it and show the feedback response.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed pathway to the body was necessary but less informative on its own; the receptor and vesicle inset suggested a mechanism without yet explaining it.

surprise.text: The attempt to connect ADH-producing neurons directly to pituitary capillaries instead revealed and automatically made the sensing circuit first.

arbitrary.text: That initial ordering was not obvious from the picture descriptions: the terminals appeared to fit the capillary bed, but the game required the sensing connection first.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connected a familiar idea, drinking water, to kidney regulation in a concrete way. The term ADH was used without spelling out its name or explaining its meaning in this chapter, however.
